chapters.title: Number systems and codes
chapters.summary: Binary, octal and hexadecimal numbers, two’s complement arithmetic, fixed-point numbers and codes such as BCD and Gray code.

chapters.title: Boolean algebra and logic gates
chapters.summary: Boolean algebra, logic gates, truth tables, and sum-of-products and product-of-sums canonical forms.

chapters.title: Logic minimisation
chapters.summary: Karnaugh maps, prime implicants, don’t-care conditions, the Quine–McCluskey method and multilevel logic.

chapters.title: Combinational building blocks
chapters.summary: Multiplexers, decoders, encoders, adders and subtractors, comparators and arithmetic logic units.

chapters.title: Latches and flip-flops
chapters.summary: Bistable elements, SR and D latches, edge-triggered flip-flops, and setup, hold and propagation timing.

chapters.title: Finite-state machines
chapters.summary: Moore and Mealy machines, state diagrams and tables, state assignment and state minimisation.

chapters.title: Registers and counters
chapters.summary: Shift registers, synchronous and asynchronous counters, and register-transfer design of simple datapaths.

chapters.title: Memories and programmable logic
chapters.summary: ROM, SRAM and DRAM organisation, programmable logic devices and FPGAs.

chapters.title: Hardware description and timing
chapters.summary: Describing hardware in Verilog, simulation and synthesis, static timing analysis and synchronous design practice.
